================================================================
1) EXACT FAILURE MECHANISM
================================================================

Architecture (from era code surviving in HEAD, reconstructed in wm7zqhnu5): multi-spine = hidden co-resident REAL vLLM Request clones (`<req_id>::lumo_ir_sN`) injected via a monkeypatched `Scheduler.add_request` (`scripts/swe_x86_helpers/relaunch_qwen36_round.py`, commits 1dcc3e5e/65fb6439). Spine-0 = native MTP top-1 chain ("= E5 by construction"); spine-s = MTP rank-s root token + ordinary chain. Each spine had its OWN native per-request GDN state row (this was the fix for FR7's packed-tree shared-scan). Per event: winner = longest-accepted-prefix row; winner tokens committed to all siblings; winner's post-accept GDN recurrent state device-copied to all S-1 sibling rows via `mamba_utils.do_mamba_copy_block` across 48 GDN layers × conv+ssm, unconditionally, every event.

Three distinct contamination channels (all confirmed in the archaeology):

- **CH-1 (Era-1, the +6.85% route): biased committer.** The PUBLIC stream served the best-of-spines winner. Serving max-over-S(longest accepted prefix) is an order statistic: greedy, every "rescue" event (4.9% recovery rate) serves tokens that are NOT native's greedy continuation; at temp>0 the served distribution is the biased `p'(z)=p(z)·(2·CDF(z)−p(z))` (the era's own Gate-C analytic negative control — which existed only as a test STUB). The served output divergence wasn't a side effect — it WAS the accept gain.
- **CH-2: state-sync feedback.** Copying the winner's post-accept recurrent state into every row puts sibling rows' state inconsistent with any native prefix ("copying a sibling spine state across a divergent prefix remains forbidden" — closeout line 309), and feeds winner-aligned state back into spine-0's own drafter+target. Measured tell: spine-0 accept ROSE under sync, 2.866 → 3.328 (closeout §4 table) — reported then as "no regression"; it is actually the drafter-target collusion signature (contamination making future drafts MORE acceptable).
- **CH-3 (the killer for the "lossless" Era-2 retrofit): GDN batch-composition non-invariance.** Even with the selector OFF, spine-0-only commits (40/40), copies clean, BI=1+FLASH_ATTN — merely CO-SCHEDULING the hidden clone changes the batch composition of the GDN/linear-attention recurrent kernels every step. vLLM #42960: GDN_ATTN is excluded from batch-invariant mode (hard-aborts). Near-tie greedy argmaxes flip; spine-0's public greedy tokens fork from spines=1 (2/4 prompts, first_diff_index 18 and 2). No after-the-fact suppression/copy can repair a perturbed public logit stream.
- (FR7 packed-tree variant, the ceiling class: ONE shared recurrent Markov state across all spines — sibling writes directly contaminate the top-1 chain's deep state; there accept COLLAPSED, 3.150→1.66, the opposite signature.)

**Why accept/TPS went UP while losslessness broke:** (a) accept = max over S spines ≥ spine-0 count BY DEFINITION — the metric's reference object (spine-0) sat inside the contaminated system, so the invariant was tautological; (b) CH-2 feedback raised even spine-0's accept (2.866→3.328) because q and p drift TOGETHER when contamination is shared; (c) TPS +6.85% at low batch because weights dominate GB10 decode (+24% accept vs ~1.17× per-event state-copy tax → net +6.85%); at production B=4 the same route was a LOSS (0.74–0.79×, 4/16 vs 8/16 resolved) — the win never existed at the deployed regime.

================================================================
3) WHAT FINALLY CAUGHT IT
================================================================

`scripts/fr9_gate_b_greedy_probe.py` — the first and only OUTPUT-EQUAL instrument on the route: collect exact temp=0 served token IDs from the live endpoint, fixed prompts, s1 arm vs s2 arm, with confounds pre-cleared (BI=1+FLASH_ATTN; same-arm b1-vs-b4 exact_match=true BOTH arms; selector off; spine-0-only commits 40/40; copies clean). Result: cross-arm `exact_match: false` — prompt 0 ("Count from one to five") forked at index 18, prompt 2 forked at index 2 into an entirely different completion. Attribution by elimination + literature: attention/GEMM controlled ⇒ residual = GDN recurrent kernels (vLLM #42960: GDN excluded from batch-invariant mode) ⇒ "co-scheduling hidden spine 1 changes spine 0's logits before any public winner selection occurs." Closure 968e6bde added the non-statistical grounds: count-only gate, copy cost doesn't scale, biased committer.

Evidentiary caveats (wm7zqhnu5, verified): the two Gate-B arms were SEPARATE BOOTS with different `max_num_seqs` (4 vs 8) — an uncontrolled boot-config confound; native itself later measured only 4/8 native-vs-native greedy-exact at B=4; no per-layer localization was ever done (CUPTI 0 rows, isolated-forward probe crashed). So the kill-shot was statistically thin by today's standards — but the class verdict (count-only gate + biased committer + #42960-class still-live mechanism) stands independently, and the wm7zqhnu5 re-attribution probe REFUTED the "it was just the cc008587 bugs" rescue.

================================================================
4) FAILURE-MODE TAXONOMY — "SUPERSET-BUT-LOSSY" (accept/event ↑ while served output ≠ native)
================================================================

A. COMMITTER serves non-target tokens
- A1 **Biased selection / order-statistic publication**: serve best-of-K by any score (longest prefix, max logprob). Accept = max-over-K rises mechanically; served dist = biased order statistic (`p(2CDF−p)` class). [Era-1 multi-spine, +6.85%]
- A2 **Wrong-row commit**: leaf-order/BFS/spine index confusion serves a different node than verify accepted (playbook class 5, `4d45be27`); accept counters keyed to the wrong object can read high.
- A3 **Bonus over-commit**: bonus token sampled from a row inconsistent with the accepted path (the H1-ROWBUG family; stock vLLM's version DEPRESSED accept — the mirror bug inflates).

B. VERIFIER over-accepts (the bar drops, not the drafts improving)
- B1 **Loosened acceptance criterion**: accept vs q instead of p, wrong rejection threshold/u-comparison, off-by-one in accepted_len.
- B2 **Drafter-target collusion via shared contaminated state**: the draft has already polluted the state/logits the target reads, so the target "confirms" its own pollution. q and p drift together → accept up, both off-native. [CH-2: spine-0 2.866→3.328 under sync; FR7's internal superset]
- B3 **Mask/causality leak**: verify logits peek at sibling/future draft tokens → systematically accept the continuation that leaked in.

C. CONTAMINATION moves the target itself
- C1 **Batch-composition non-invariance**: co-resident hidden rows/branches change reduction order in non-BI kernels (GDN #42960) → near-tie argmax flips; flips correlate with the draft because the drafter ran in the same regime. [CH-3]
- C2 **Shared recurrent state across spines** (packed tree, no per-path scan): direct sibling writes into the top-1 chain's deep state. [FR7, accept-collapse signature — same class, opposite sign]
- C3 **State copy across divergent prefixes**: served prefix and recurrent state desynced; subsequent verify evaluates a target that is not native-on-the-served-path. [CH-2 sibling rows]

D. DRAFTER changes leak into the p-side
- D1 Drafter writes into buffers/KV/state the target forward reads (double lm-head side effects, shared prep buffers — the FIX-2-era per-group prep-buffer bug was this class).
- D2 Spine proposals stop being native-equivalent after partial accepts (state-preservation precondition failure, `FR13_B1_SUPERSET_PRECONDITION_BIND.md`) — there it cost accept; the mirror (drafts adapted to the contaminated target) inflates it.

E. MEASUREMENT artifacts that inflate accept / mask divergence
- E1 **Count-only superset vs an INTERNAL baseline** (winner≥spine-0, winner≥path0): tautological; both objects contaminated. [the headline blind spot]
- E2 **Denominator games**: per-winner-event vs per-draft-event (1.398 vs 0.402 on the same run); TPS÷accept hand-rolls (2× retracted); aggregate vs per-request decode-seconds.
- E3 **Bookkeeping-as-correctness**: copy_missing=0 / viol=0 / no-crash certify the mechanism ran, not that output is native (class-9 vacuous instrument).
- E4 **Underpowered/confounded equivalence tests**: 1-run-pair self-floors, 512-sample temp tests with autoregressive tokens counted as iid, quality endpoints (SWE resolved-rate) as losslessness proxies, cross-boot arms with different boot config (max_num_seqs 4 vs 8), single-draw noise floors.
- E5 **Forced/teacher-forced proofs standing in for free-running** (64/64 forced-LCP): forcing bypasses the state-feedback channel (playbook class 8: offline/forced ≠ live multi-step).

================================================================

================================================================

The user's bet substantially HOLDS. Coverage map:
- **E1/A1 closed by definition**: FR13_DIRECTION_AND_NUMBERS "LOSSLESS, PRECISELY" = token-level greedy identity + per-depth argmax + temp>0 distributional, explicitly "not merely that it serves or accepts more tokens"; the reference is NATIVE (external), with the branch-oracle = native-on-the-branch-path.

- **OUTPUT-EQUAL is now the headline gate**: the in-flight B=1 gold gate (b7887c89, FR13_TRAIL B1-3/gate-regime) = greedy SERVED-STREAM byte-identity vs native E5 per request on full uncapped SWE tasks, with model-vs-env fork attribution and same-flag cross-boot floor pairs — exactly the fr9_gate_b probe class, but as the standing verdict instrument rather than a post-hoc kill-shot.
- **C1/C3 covered**: measured native same-seed B=4 floor 0.113 (multi-sample, supersedes single-draw 0.0593), native-vs-native control arms (class 11), B=1 same-seed repeat as first gate (class 8), boot-config pinned in campaign regimes (FIX-A bind: identical regime, "THE ONLY VARIABLE = FR13_TREE_SAMPLE_ROW"). The Gate-B boot-confound class is structurally fixed.
- **E3 covered**: class-9 engagement asserts + needles per arm; E2 covered by class-12 raw-counters rule; accept draws explicitly labeled "a DRAW, not a gate" (FIX-A bind).
- **B2/D coverage partial-but-real**: G2 dual-path selfcheck (sampled row == published leaf row 232/232), G5 chain-neutrality arm, regular-decode==pristine verifier-only proof, SPEED-WORK SCOPE CONSTRAINT (never touch shared/native machinery — protects spine≡native premise).

REMAINING GAPS (3 found) + designed missing checks:

- **GAP-1 — over-masking vacuity in the corruption gate (class-9 inverse).** `_self_noise_mask` fail-closes only on EMPTY mask; `mask_positions` is recorded but unbounded above. A bad noise arm (wrong seed/shape, or a coincidentally noisy native pair — the comment itself expects ~0.23 coverage) can swallow most positions, making real_loss_rate vacuously low; likewise `bag_tv_budget = max(0.0593, native_self_bag_tv)` lets ONE noisy native draw inflate the budget (class-12 single-draw floor, and the hardcoded 0.0593 is the superseded floor — should be the measured 0.113/p95 protocol). **Missing check: a mask-coverage ceiling** — FAIL (valid=False) if mask covers > ~35% of compared positions or > p95 of the banked native-floor mask-coverage distribution, and replace the single-draw `native_self_bag_tv` with the multi-sample p95 floor from `FR13_NUM_SPLITS_NATIVE_FLOOR_BIND.md`.
- **GAP-2 — no over-acceptance instrument (taxonomy B is one-sided).** Metric 3 only fails on accept DROP (the FR7 signature); an over-accepting verifier (B1/B2) PASSES Metric 3 by design and must be caught downstream — works at greedy (byte-identity/argmax), but at temp 0.6 the only net is bag-TV, which is order-insensitive and low-power against a subtle q-ward bias hiding under the 0.113 floor (the multi-spine bias was exactly this shape: per-event ~+0.27 tokens). **Missing check: ACCEPT-DECISION REPLAY gate** — log per-node (p_logits-row-hash, q, u/seed, committed token) on gated runs and re-verify every accept offline against the canonical rule (greedy: committed token at depth d == independently-recomputed argmax of the verify logits at the parent row, every depth; temp>0: accept iff u ≤ p/q under the bound generator, MSS decomposition for branches); violations must be 0. This is CPU-side, reuses the capture-payload harness + the banked rejection-sampler convergence methodology, and is the exact dual of G2's row-identity selfcheck (G2 proves WHICH row; this proves the DECISION on that row).
- **GAP-3 — accept-rise events have no contamination-direction probe.** When accept jumps after a change (FIX-A 2.03→3.18; era spine-0 2.866→3.328 under sync), today's gates check the served stream is unchanged/native — but the era showed accept can rise BECAUSE of p/q co-drift (B2) before the served fork is visible at probe scale. **Missing check (cheap rider): forced-prefix verify-channel TV** — on every accept-improving change, run the banked lockstep/forced-decode comparison (identical committed prefixes, both arms) and require the verify-logits top-k TV vs native-on-the-same-prefix within floor; an accept gain with verify-TV drift = B2 collusion, FAIL regardless of accept. (FIX-A partially did this via fingerprint-normalization-to-chain-class + chain-neutrality — generalize it into a standing precondition: "accept may only rise while the verify channel stays within floor on forced prefixes.")

Bottom line: the 2026-06 regime kills the 2026-06-02 bug — superset is now measured against NATIVE with output-equality as the verdict instrument and count-draws demoted to non-gates; the three residual gaps are (1) an unbounded self-noise mask + stale single-draw bag-TV budget in `scripts/fr13_corruption_gate.py`, (2) no standing over-acceptance (accept-decision replay) gate for temp>0, (3) no mandatory forced-prefix verify-TV rider on accept-improving changes.

## SPECIAL-ATTENTION ANSWERS

**Over-acceptance (verify accepting tokens native's argmax would reject):** by committer construction an "accepted" token always equals the TREE verify's own argmax (`drafts[node]==parent_targets[node]`), so over-acceptance can only happen via a contaminated verify forward whose argmaxes drift toward q — which necessarily changes served bytes at greedy. Gates that catch it: gold gate M-fork byte compare (b) and corruption-gate M1/M2 (d) — both output-equal. Gates that CANNOT catch it: FIX-A G1-G6 (a), committer math + S1 (c), corruption-gate M3 and `evaluate_superset_hard_gate` (count-only, one-sided), and the committer's internal `superset_violation` field (the literal fr7 trap, still emitted at `fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:5626`). **No current gate alarms on accept/event ABOVE native per se** — the class is covered iff the output-equality gates run and bind.

**FIX-A specifically (q-side change; which gate PROVES served tokens stay target-argmax?):** none of the gates already PASSED prove it vs native — the FIX-A bind's served-stream evidence is tree-ON vs tree-OFF (floor-class on 3/4 prompts) and the bind explicitly reserves the e2e-vs-E5 verdict. The q-side-only argument has a known leak path: accept-pattern→state-bank wiring feedback (conv prior-window/h0/KV-slot classes 4/7) can alter the NEXT event's verify forward. **The gold gate's design DOES close this**: tree (FIX-A ON, env-pinned `FR13_TREE_SAMPLE_ROW=1`) vs native E5 served-stream byte compare on matched request prefixes over 1-2 full 30-min agentic tasks at greedy is exactly token-level target-argmax identity; with the t0.6 riders it covers the deployed temp by fork-position proxy. Confirmation is CONDITIONAL on its two design soft spots: the first-fork-only reading and the min-floor rule including the tree's own cross-boot floor.

## THE MISSING CHECKS (design)

1. **GATE-OA "accept-gain output-neutrality" (the genuinely missing instrument, CPU-only from existing artifacts):** lockstep-pair tree vs native events on identical served prefixes (banked lockstep instrument); for every event where tree accept beats native, require (i) the rescue alt token == native's served bonus token at the paired native event, and (ii) the post-rescue served tail rejoins native's stream byte-exact. Inputs already logged: `tree_path_lcp.jsonl` (`winner_path`, `emitted_tokens`, `path_scores`, parent/self targets) + native `per_req_spec_trace.jsonl` + served streams. Make the corruption-gate accept check TWO-SIDED: fail if `accept_delta > rescue_headroom` where headroom = measured off-spine-winner rate × 1 token/event (+slack) — accept above native must be ACCOUNTED, not just celebrated.
2. **Gold-gate floor-rule hardening:** bind the verdict to the NATIVE-native floor; if the tree-tree floor forks EARLIER than the native-native floor, flag it as its own finding (tree self-nondeterminism = contamination symptom), never use it to widen the excuse window. Add fork-density/byte-identical-fraction over matched requests as a second statistic, not just first-fork position.
3. **Corruption-gate repairs before B4-1 reads:** fail-loud (invalid, not silent None) when `tree_path_lcp`/`per_req_spec_trace` traces are absent (class 9); update `BAG_TV_FLOOR` to the measured 0.113/p95 protocol; note `evaluate_superset_hard_gate` as count-only in its output so it is never quoted as output evidence.
4. **Promote the branch-token oracle (live-vs-live form) to a standing rider** on any campaign claiming accept > native — per-accepted-node native-argmax check is the only instrument that localizes over-acceptance to the node rather than reading it off trajectory bytes.

synthesis.gapsAndAdditions:
All additions are CPU-side reductions over artifacts already logged (GB10-safe, no GPU, extend existing instruments).

GAP-1 — corruption-gate self-noise mask unbounded above + stale floor (`/home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/scripts/fr13_corruption_gate.py`). `_self_noise_mask` (:170-198) fail-closes only on EMPTY (:384-389); a noisy/wrong noise arm can swallow most positions and make real_loss_rate vacuously low; `bag_tv_budget = max(BAG_TV_FLOOR, native_self_bag_tv)` (:411) lets ONE noisy native draw inflate the budget, and `BAG_TV_FLOOR=0.0593` (:123) is the superseded single-draw floor. ADD: (1a) mask-coverage ceiling immediately after :378 — `coverage = len(mask)/compared_positions`; if coverage > banked p95 of the native-floor mask-coverage distribution (interim 0.35), append to `invalid` -> valid=False; (1b) set BAG_TV_FLOOR to the measured 0.113 / multi-sample p95 protocol (`FR13_NUM_SPLITS_NATIVE_FLOOR_BIND.md`); require >=2 native-self draws for the budget's adaptive term, else use the fixed floor and record native_self as observational.

GAP-2 — no over-acceptance instrument; taxonomy-B is one-sided (the multi-spine hole shape). ADD four pieces, all slotting into the corruption gate / its reducer: (2a) fail-loud traces: `_superset_from_traces` (:299-306) must return an "invalid" marker instead of None; in `run_gate` (:432) a None when the run claims accept>native => `invalid.append` (class-9 vacuity in the advertised winner>=NATIVE detector). (2b) TWO-SIDED accept check after :429: fail if `accept_delta > rescue_headroom + slack`, headroom = off-spine-winner rate x 1 token/event computed from `tree_path_lcp.jsonl` (`winner_leaf != spine_leaf` fraction — same trace the gate already loads); accept above native must be ACCOUNTED, not celebrated. (2c) GATE-OA accept-gain output-neutrality (new function, same file): for every rescue event (winner path leaves the spine at depth d), assert committed alt token == `native_bonus_token` — ALREADY LOGGED per event by the committer (:5637-5641) — and that the post-rescue served tail rejoins native byte-exact (paired via the gold-gate matched-prefix machinery). Pure CPU reduction over existing logs. (2d) accept-decision REPLAY: re-derive `best_lcp`/emitted row offline from the logged `draft_token_ids` + `parent_target_ids` (both in `path_log_rows`, :5640+) and assert == `emitted_tokens`/`accepted_token_rows`; catches A2/A3/B1 committer regressions independent of any live arm. Also: rename or annotate the committer's `superset_violation` field (:5626) as `internal_path0_count_only` so the literal fr7 trap can never be quoted as the superset verdict, and have `_superset_from_traces` label `evaluate_superset_hard_gate` output "count-only" in its JSON.

GAP-3 — gold-gate floor rule + first-fork-only reading (`/home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/output/fr13_b1_gold_swe/reduce_gold_compare.py`). The floor-bracket (:421-446) takes the MIN over BOTH pairs including tree_a:tree_b — a less-deterministic tree build lowers its own bar; `compare_pair` (:145-214) reads only the FIRST fork, everything after = `post_fork_tail` unread. ADD: (3a) bind attributability to the native_a:native_b floor ONLY; tree-tree floor forking earlier than native-native = a SEPARATE "TREE_SELF_NONDET" finding (itself a contamination symptom), never a wider excuse window; (3b) add per-request fork-position histogram + byte-identical-served fraction + fork density as second statistics (each matched request already compares independently, so this is a reducer change only); (3c) fail-loud `request_temperatures_seen` (:412): greedy verdict arm must be exactly {0.0} else invalid; (3d) accept-vs-bytes cross-check: accept>native on a byte-identical request = legitimate rescue; accept>native on a FORKED request = suspect, flag for GATE-OA.

GAP-4 — temp>0 over-acceptance has no standing detector (the only true structural hole). At t0.6 the gold riders are fork-position proxies and M2 bag-TV is order-insensitive and low-power against a per-event ~+0.27-token q-ward bias hiding under the 0.113 floor (exactly the multi-spine bias shape). ADD the forced-prefix verify-channel TV rider as a standing PRECONDITION on every accept-improving change: run the banked lockstep/forced-decode comparison on identical committed prefixes and require verify-logits top-k TV vs native-on-the-same-prefix within floor — an accept gain with verify-TV drift = B2 collusion, FAIL regardless of accept. Longer-term: log per-node (q, sampled target, seed) on gated t0.6 runs and replay accept decisions against the canonical rule offline (extends the 2d replay).

GAP-5 — branch-token oracle not in the standing battery. `/home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/scripts/fr13_branch_token_oracle.py` (per-accepted-node native-on-path argmax, SpecInfer Def 4.1) is the only instrument that localizes over-acceptance to the NODE rather than reading it off trajectory bytes. Promote its live-vs-live form to a mandatory rider on any campaign claiming accept > native (B4-1 included); fail-closed on stream misalignment as it already does.
synthesis.verdictForUser:
DIRECT ANSWER: YES with three repairs at greedy/B=1; NO as-stands for temp>0 over-acceptance. The user's bet substantially holds — the gold gate is precisely the instrument class whose absence let multi-spine ship (output-equal vs an EXTERNAL native reference, free-running, full workload), and the three architectural channels that made multi-spine lossy are absent from cat9+FIX-A by construction.

EXCLUDED BY CONSTRUCTION for FIX-A (no live gate needed for existence, only regression guards): A1 order-statistic publication — no hidden co-resident Request clones exist; the committer can only emit verify-forward tokens (`drafts[node]==parent_targets[node]` / parent- or self-target rows, fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:5538-5610), so there is no best-of-K object to publish. C2 shared recurrent state across spines and C3 per-event state copies — the no-copy per-path tree-scan has neither; no `do_mamba_copy_block` in the path. A2/A3 wrong-row/bonus — constrained by the S1 spine fix + `tree_self_target` math, but these are code not architecture, so the gold gate's byte-compare remains their regression guard.

NEED THE EMPIRICAL GATES (q-side-only argument is insufficient): B2 — FIX-A changes accept patterns, and accept-pattern->state-bank wiring (conv prior-window/h0/KV-slot, classes 4/7) can move the NEXT event's verify forward; none of the PASSED FIX-A gates G1-G6 can see this (all internal; the bind itself reserves the e2e-vs-E5 verdict, deviation 4). The RUNNING gold gate closes it at greedy: any verify-argmax drift forks served bytes -> MODEL_SERVED_FORK judged vs floors. B1/B3 — same channel, same closure. C1 batch-composition — structurally absent at B=1 (single request); at B=4 it is the known live carrier and B4-1's M1/M2 are the designed instrument. D1 — verifier-only proof + scope constraint + gold-gate backstop.

PER-MECHANISM SUFFICIENCY OF (gold gate now + B4-1 next): A1/C2/C3 yes (construction). A2/A3 yes (gold byte-compare). B1/B2/B3 at greedy yes — CONDITIONAL on reading the gold verdict against the native-native floor only and adding fork-density beyond the first fork (GAP-3); at t0.6 NO — M3 is one-sided (:424-429), bag-TV is low-power, no acceptance-replay exists (GAP-4). C1 at B=4 yes IF the corruption-gate repairs land before B4-1 reads (GAP-1: mask ceiling + 0.113 floor; GAP-2a: fail-loud on absent traces — otherwise the very winner>=NATIVE detector can pass silently vacuous). D1/D2 yes. E-class: policy-covered except the three instrument bugs above.

One sentence: the 2026-06 regime kills the 2026-06-02 bug class at the verdict tier, multi-spine's specific machinery cannot recur in this architecture, and the remaining exposure is (1) instrument hygiene in the two gates about to bind and (2) a missing two-sided/over-acceptance net at temp>0 — both fixable as CPU-side extensions of existing artifacts before B4-1 reads.
synthesis.risks: 1) B4-1 vacuous-pass risk (highest, actionable now): `_superset_from_traces` silently returns None when `tree_path_lcp.jsonl`/`per_req_spec_trace.jsonl` are absent (fr13_corruption_gate.py:299-306) — the gate still passes on summaries; combined with the unbounded self-noise mask and the stale 0.0593 single-draw floor term, B4-1 could green-light a contaminated build. Land GAP-1/2a before reading B4-1. 2) Gold-gate excuse-window risk: the min-over-both-floors rule lets tree self-nondeterminism (itself a class-1/3 contamination symptom) excuse tree-vs-native forks, and floors are n=1-2 draws forking at ~5-22 served tokens on agentic trajectories — a real early fork could be read WITHIN-FLOOR; read the verdict vs the native-native floor and demand fork-density, not just first-fork. 3) First-fork blindness: corruption appearing only after one benign within-floor fork is currently unmeasured (post_fork_tail unread). 4) Misquote risk: the committer still emits `superset_violation = best_lcp < path0_lcp` (:5626) — the literal retracted fr7 count trap — and `evaluate_superset_hard_gate` is count-only even vs native; either can be quoted as "superset verified" in a future doc exactly as 7897ef1e did. 5) temp>0 standing hole: a B2-class bias inflating accept at t0.6 while staying under the bag-TV budget has NO detector today; the deployed temperature is 0.6, so a greedy-clean gold pass does not close the deployed regime without the GAP-4 rider. 6) accept 3.1789 > 3.1613 is a single draw vs a banked number; per the 2026-06-12 rescue ruling accept>native is EXPECTED at greedy, so high accept alone alarms nothing — the rescue-headroom accounting (GAP-2b/2c) is what distinguishes genuine branch rescue from collusion. 7) Gold-gate dependency: its verdict is only as good as the FULL-RUN HEALTH RULE — an early-exiting task (proxy flake/tool-parse crash classes) silently shrinks the compared window; wall-consumed assert must bind. 8) The branch-token oracle remains unbanked into any pass/fail — without it, over-acceptance can only ever be read off trajectory bytes, never localized to the accepting node.
